title: Gloss that echoes the form
description: This check finds senses whose gloss is only the entry's form written in capitals: XYZ on xyz-, or the capitals followed by a dotted suffix (XYZ.V). Hyphens and = are ignored, and any allomorph form of the entry counts. A gloss that adds only a dotted suffix is the mark of a clone entry made to carry a feature. A gloss written in the same case as the form, such as a proper name or a loanword (radar on radar), is not reported, because it can be a real gloss.
